thread:
Maya P: Quick sync note — Customer Alpha asked for identity-propagation header + audit logs for the SSO plugin during today's pilot review. They said it's a blocker for their pilot next month.
Jon L: How urgent is this? timeline impact?
Tara (PM): Customer is firm. Pilot target is ~3 weeks out. If we don't have this they won't go live for the pilot (they said "must have").
Sam K: KMS/HSM bits are the biggest unknown. If we punt KMS we can do header+logs faster.
Jon L: Rough back-of-envelope: header propagation + basic logging = 5d dev + 3d QA. KMS integration + secrets rotation adds ~4d infra + ops review.
Maya P: Options on the table:
  1) Pull into MVP and shift launch ~2w (full KMS later)
  2) Defer to v1 but guarantee compatibility and canary path
  3) Ship MVP with stubbed header + feature-flagged logging (fast path)
Jon L: If we delay MVP, other integration work slips. We could try parallel: one engineer focuses on header proxy + flagging, infra scopes KMS in parallel.
Sam K: For the basic logs we can write to S3 behind a feature flag. That avoids immediate KMS work. I'll scope required bucket + IAM changes.
Tara (PM): What is minimum acceptable for Customer Alpha to run their pilot? Header + logs to S3, KMS later. They explicitly called out the header as non-negotiable.
Maya P: OK proposed plan: include header + basic S3 audit logs in MVP behind a feature flag. KMS + HSM review moves to v1. Need biz + security signoff for S3 temporary approach.
Jon L: Agree. Add risk: more E2E tests and console toggle UI. We'll need tasks: ENG-3472 (header proxy), ENG-3473 (logging), QA-498, DOCS-221 (admin docs).
Sam K: I'll produce infra ETA by EOD and confirm whether S3-only approach passes security checklist.
release-bot: Note: current MVP deploy window is 2024-06-12. Moving launch by ~2w requires updating the release calendar: https://go/release-calendar
Tara (PM): I'll update milestone tracker, notify sales enablement + support, and schedule a 15m sync with security for signoff.
Maya P: Thanks — I'll update the roadmap doc with the slice change and action items, looping in Legal & Security. Posting the new slice plan to the tracker after security ok.
Jon L: Sounds good. Flagging for triage tomorrow: we'll bring ENG-3472/3473 to standup and reassign priorities.
Sam K: :thumbsup: will post infra checklist later.
Tara (PM): If security rejects S3, fallback is to delay MVP 2w while we finish KMS. Let's hope not.
Maya P: Action owners: Jon -> ENG tasks, Sam -> infra ETA + checklist, Tara -> stakeholder comms. I'll run the roadmap update.
Jon L: Got it.
Maya P: Thanks team — short but decisive.
